{"Implementation approach":"Preserve protocol-required files exactly. Build a single core library from all non-Main sources and link both the demo executable and the single test executable against it via CMake. Separate pure domain logic (Bird, Pipe, GameState) from environment boundaries (seeded RNG adapter and runtime main). Keep headers self-contained with the standard includes they need. Drive all updates with a deterministic dt and a seeded RNG boundary interface (IRandom) to ensure reproducible unit tests. The runtime entry is a small, non-interactive, headless simulation demo that steps the engine deterministically and prints final status, then exits. Tests are concise, deterministic, headless, and assert externally visible behavior through the canonical public API declared under include/.","Domain Decomposition":[["[Alex] Build configuration and targets; 2-3 tests: bird physics trend after flap; scoring when a pipe passes; collision + reset; deterministic dt and seed; main returns 0 on pass; include <cassert>, <iostream>","tests/test_main.cpp","automated-test"]],"File list":["CMakeLists.txt","include/Random.h","src/Random.cpp","include/GameConfig.h","src/GameConfig.cpp","include/Bird.h","src/Bird.cpp","include/Pipe.h","src/Pipe.cpp","include/GameState.h","src/GameState.cpp","include/GameEngine.h","src/GameEngine.cpp","src/Main.cpp","tests/test_main.cpp"],"Canonical File References":["CMakeLists.txt","include/Random.h","src/Random.cpp","include/GameConfig.h","src/GameConfig.cpp","include/Bird.h","src/Bird.cpp","include/Pipe.h","src/Pipe.cpp","include/GameState.h","src/GameState.cpp","include/GameEngine.h","src/GameEngine.cpp","src/Main.cpp","tests/test_main.cpp"],"Data structures and interfaces":"classDiagram
    class IRandom {
        <<interface>>
        +~IRandom()
        +nextUnit() double
    }
    class LcgRandom {
        -uint64_t state_
        +LcgRandom(seed: uint64_t)
        +nextUnit() double
        +nextUint64() uint64_t
    }
    IRandom <|.. LcgRandom

    class GameConfig {
        +worldWidth: double
        +worldHeight: double
        +gravity: double
        +flapImpulse: double
        +maxFallSpeed: double
        +pipeSpeed: double
        +pipeWidth: double
        +pipeGapHeight: double
        +pipeSpawnInterval: double
        +birdX: double
        +birdWidth: double
        +birdHeight: double
        +Default() GameConfig
        +validate() void
    }

    class Bird {
        -y_: double
        -v_: double
        +Bird(y0: double, v0: double)
        +flap(cfg: GameConfig) void
        +update(dt: double, cfg: GameConfig) void
        +y() double
        +velocity() double
        +top(cfg: GameConfig) double
        +bottom(cfg: GameConfig) double
        +reset(y0: double) void
    }

    class Pipe {
        +x: double
        +gapY: double
        +scored: bool
        +Pipe(x0: double, gapY0: double)
        +update(dt: double, cfg: GameConfig) void
        +isOffscreen(cfg: GameConfig) bool
        +hasPassedBird(birdX: double, cfg: GameConfig) bool
        +collidesWithBird(birdX: double, birdTop: double, birdBottom: double, cfg: GameConfig) bool
    }

    class GameState {
        -cfg_: GameConfig
        -bird_: Bird
        -pipes_: std::vector<Pipe>
        -score_: int
        -gameOver_: bool
        -timeSinceLastPipe_: double
        +GameState(cfg: GameConfig)
        +reset() void
        +flap() void
        +update(dt: double, rng: IRandom&) void
        +score() int
        +gameOver() bool
        +pipes() const std::vector<Pipe>&
        +birdY() double
        +birdTop() double
        +birdBottom() double
    }

    class GameEngine {
        -cfg_: GameConfig
        -rng_: std::unique_ptr<IRandom>
        -state_: GameState
        +GameEngine(cfg: GameConfig, rng: std::unique_ptr<IRandom>)
        +reset() void
        +flap() void
        +step(dt: double) void
        +score() int
        +isGameOver() bool
        +birdY() double
        +pipes() const std::vector<Pipe>&
        +config() const GameConfig&
    }

    GameState --> Bird
    GameState --> Pipe
    GameState --> GameConfig
    GameState ..> IRandom
    GameEngine --> GameState
    GameEngine --> GameConfig
    GameEngine --> IRandom","Program call flow":"sequenceDiagram
    participant M as Main (src/Main.cpp)
    participant GE as GameEngine
    participant GS as GameState
    participant B as Bird
    participant P as Pipe(s)
    participant R as IRandom (LcgRandom)

    M->>GE: construct(GameConfig::Default(), make_unique<LcgRandom>(42))
    loop Fixed ticks
        M->>GE: step(dt)
        GE->>GS: update(dt, *rng)
        GS->>B: update(dt, cfg)
        alt Spawn due
            GS->>R: nextUnit()
            R-->>GS: u in [0,1)
            GS->>P: create Pipe(worldWidth, gapY)
        end
        GS->>P: update(dt, cfg) for each
        GS->>GS: check pass -> score++ (once)
        GS->>GS: check AABB collisions and bounds -> gameOver?
    end
    M->>GE: flap() at intervals
    GE->>GS: flap()
    M-->>M: print final score and state","Domain Mapping":[["Build and test orchestration via CMake","CMakeLists.txt"],["RNG boundary and deterministic sequence provider","include/Random.h"],["LCG RNG - struct IRandom { virtual ~IRandom() noexcept = default; virtual double nextUnit() = 0; }.
- class LcgRandom : public IRandom { explicit LcgRandom(std::uint64_t seed); std::uint64_t nextUint64(); double nextUnit() override; }.
Semantics: LcgRandom implements a 64-bit LCG with constants a=6364136223846793005, c=1; state is updated per call. nextUint64() returns the new state; nextUnit() returns (nextUint64() / (std::numeric_limits<uint64_t>::max()+1.0)) in [0,1).

include/GameConfig.h: struct GameConfig {
 double worldWidth, worldHeight; double gravity; double flapImpulse; double maxFallSpeed; double pipeSpeed; double pipeWidth; double pipeGapHeight; double pipeSpawnInterval; double birdX; double birdWidth; double birdHeight;
 static GameConfig Default(); void validate() const; }.
Semantics: Default() returns sane gameplay values. validate() throws std::invalid_argument on invalid: non-positive sizes/speeds; pipeGapHeight < worldHeight must hold; 0 <= birdX <= worldWidth-birdWidth; pipeWidth > 0; pipeSpawnInterval > 0; etc.

include/Bird.h: class Bird { public: Bird(double y0, double v0); void flap(const GameConfig& cfg); void update(double dt, const GameConfig& cfg); double y() const noexcept; double velocity() const noexcept; double top(const GameConfig& cfg) const noexcept; double bottom(const GameConfig& cfg) const noexcept; void reset(double y0) noexcept; }.
Semantics: Coordinates: y increases upward; top() = y()+birdHeight/2; bottom() = y()-birdHeight/2. flap() adds positive cfg.flapImpulse to velocity. update() applies gravity (v -= cfg.gravity*dt), clamps v >= -cfg.maxFallSpeed, integrates y += v*dt, clamps bird within [0, worldHeight] using std::clamp; touching top or bottom clamps position and may be considered a boundary contact by GameState.

include/Pipe.h: class Pipe { public: double x; double gapY; bool scored; Pipe(double x0, double gapY0); void update(double dt, const GameConfig& cfg); bool isOffscreen(const GameConfig& cfg) const; bool hasPassedBird(double birdX, const GameConfig& cfg) const; bool collidesWithBird(double birdX, double birdTop, double birdBottom, const GameConfig& cfg) const; }.
Semantics: Pipes move left at cfg.pipeSpeed: x -= cfg.pipeSpeed * dt. isOffscreen() true when x + pipeWidth < 0. hasPassedBird() true when x + pipeWidth < birdX. collidesWithBird() performs axis-aligned check: if bird overlaps pipe x-range [x, x+pipeWidth], then collision occurs unless bird is within vertical gap [gapY - pipeGapHeight/2, gapY + pipeGapHeight/2].

include/GameState.h: class GameState { public: explicit GameState(GameConfig cfg); void reset(); void flap(); void update(double dt, IRandom& rng); int score() const noexcept; bool gameOver() const noexcept; const std::vector<Pipe>& pipes() const noexcept; double birdY() const noexcept; double birdTop() const noexcept; double birdBottom() const noexcept; }.
Semantics: Owns Bird, Pipes, score, gameOver flag, and a spawn timer. Constructor stores cfg and initializes Bird centered vertically with zero velocity. reset() clears pipes/score/timer and recenters Bird. flap() delegates to Bird unless gameOver. update(): if gameOver, returns; else updates Bird, updates existing Pipes, spawns a new Pipe when timer exceeds cfg.pipeSpawnInterval: gapY derived from rng.nextUnit()*playable-range; clamps gap within play area; increments score exactly once per Pipe when it passes birdX; sets gameOver if collision with a Pipe or if Bird touches top/bottom; removes offscreen Pipes.

include/GameEngine.h: class GameEngine { public: GameEngine(GameConfig cfg, std::unique_ptr<IRandom> rng); void reset(); void flap(); void step(double dt); int score() const noexcept; bool isGameOver() const noexcept; double birdY() const noexcept; const std::vector<Pipe>& pipes() const noexcept; const GameConfig& config() const noexcept; }.
Semantics: Validates cfg in ctor (cfg.validate()). Holds RNG and GameState. step(dt) calls state_.update(dt, *rng_). flap() calls state_.flap() if not game over. reset() reinitializes GameState with same cfg and preserved RNG object/state.

Include and link rules: tests/test_main.cpp may include only headers under include/. Implementations reside in src/ and are compiled into a single core library. The runtime demo src/Main.cpp is environment-dependent and not linked into tests.","Shared Knowledge":"Build via CMake: a single core library from all non-Main src/*.cpp files, linked to both the demo executable (src/Main.cpp) and the test executable (tests/test_main.cpp). Tests include only declared headers under include/ and never include src/*.cpp. Domain separation: pure deterministic core (Random, GameConfig, Bird, Pipe, GameState, GameEngine) vs environment boundary (Main). RNG is a seeded boundary (IRandom/LcgRandom) to guarantee reproducibility. All updates driven by deterministic dt.","Execution Protocol":"Runtime entry: src/Main.cpp. Test target: tests/test_main.cpp. Build commands: mkdir -p build && cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build. Both runtime and test link against the same core library.","Anything UNCLEAR":""}
